record.question:
The marks obtained (out of 100) by a class of 80 students are given below:

Marks: 10–20 | 20–30 | 30–50 | 50–70 | 70–100
Number of students: 6 | 17 | 15 | 16 | 26

A student of the class is selected at random. The probability that she/he gets 20 or more marks but less than 70 marks is –
